references.label: Rainy residential street at night: curved single-arm lamps, gate lanterns, lit stall
references.ownerInterpretation: Night street reference: street lighting, compound lighting, lit windows, stalls, wet-road look.
references.observed: A wet two-lane street at night with dashed white lines and black-and-white kerbs on a paver sidewalk. Tall single-arm streetlights with a long curved arm and a hot white-orange luminaire stand on the sidewalks, the nearest about 9 to 10 m high, the next ones receding at roughly 25 to 30 m, on both sides. On the left a compound wall with capped piers and an ornate black steel gate has small warm lanterns on the piers and the wall, a two-storey villa behind shows warm lit windows and a balcony, red-flowering shrubs and a large shade tree stand in front. On the right low houses and a lit fruit stall with a red-and-white awning and bulbs, a green road sign reading 'KANO A Greater Nigeria' with a mosque icon, a lattice telecom tower with red aviation lights, a full moon with clouds, rain streaks, haze. The wet road carries long vertical amber reflections of every lamp and pools of light on the sidewalk and walls.
